text:
rachel_cs: Quick capture from three onboarding calls today. Common asks: per-route cost breakdown (some want hourly), an admin guided onboarding checklist, and sample prompts for regulated workflows. Also two customers asked about renewal visibility if usage drops.

devin_pm: Which customers? Any that would pay for prioritized delivery?

rachel_cs: Parkview and HelixCardio mentioned renewals in ~45 days. Parkview said they'd consider paying for an early per-route billing alpha.

lucy_csm: Paste from call: "Finance won't sign off without cost by feature/route." Also: "We need templates for clinical prompts that include redaction examples."

omar_eng: For per-route cost we can ship a CSV export first: aggregate tokens by route+day. Backend spike ~2 dev-days, minimal frontend ~1 day for download. Example query: SELECT route, date(created_at) as day, sum(tokens_in+tokens_out) as tokens FROM requests WHERE customer_id='parkview' GROUP BY route, day;

triage-bot: Reminder: add feature request to productboard and tag 'renewal-risk' and 'onboarding' https://productboard.example/redwood

devin_pm: Plan: 1) CS confirm Parkview alpha opt-in (rachel/lucy) 2) Eng spike CSV export (omar) 3) PM files productboard ticket + links (devin) 4) Target alpha in ~6 weeks for opt-ins. Agree?
rachel_cs: Agree. I'll confirm Parkview today and update this thread.
lucy_csm: Also capturing: request for an "admin-only guided walkthrough" and an exportable audit pack for compliance.
omar_eng: Noted. Exportable audit pack could be a ZIP with logs and config snippets. Low lift.
devin_pm: Thanks team. Please add any follow-up notes here.
